purpose: 2x2 process diagnostic: libwinpthread-1.dll source (Git for Windows copy vs WinLibs copy matching the toolchain that built the models) x launcher (PowerShell vs Git Bash), through the integration's original reproducing code path at commit 9edcbac. Diagnostic only; no fix is implemented.

code_path.description: resident model/preload DLLs, scoped joined sampler pools, ReplicatedStanTarget with 4 concurrently evaluated replica modules on Windows (the bridgestan_owned_worker_v1 comparator, 16/180 0xC0000374)

model.note: WP50 rebuild (BridgeStan 2.9.0, Stan 2.39.0, WinLibs GCC 16.1.0, no STAN_THREADS); the prior studies' model binary no longer exists

libwinpthread_manipulation: the chosen copy sits beside a byte-identical child exe in build/arms/<git|winlibs>/; the application directory is first in the Windows DLL search order, so it binds regardless of PATH. Verified per child from GetModuleFileNameW.

powershell.environment: registry Machine;User PATH, no Git Bash variables (a fresh user PowerShell session)

bash.environment: same registry base; the Git Bash login profile then prepends its own directories (incl. Git mingw64 in) as an interactive Git Bash session does
bash.exit_code_fidelity: MSYS maps NTSTATUS crashes to 127; true code recovered from Application Error Event 1000 correlated by child PID and exe path

child_shape.note: identical to the bridgestan_owned_worker_v1 comparator child (+ runtime-module logging)

seeds.note: each seed runs once in every one of the 4 cells (paired); exact-word search found base 50600000 unused

ordering: ascending seed; within seed i (0-based) the 4 cells run in cell_order rotated left by i mod 4 (balanced Latin square), strictly sequential

power.source: bridgestan_owned_worker_v1 comparator 16/180 heap corruption (sblrc-only 10/60 fault union = 0.167)
power.margin_test: one-sided Fisher exact on factor margins (120 vs 120): k faults vs 0 gives p=0.030 at k=5; P(Bin(120,0.089)>=5)=0.985

classification.fault: launcher timeout, nonzero launcher return code, missing/non-ok raw output, heartbeat sequence != expected, or a correlated Application Error Event 1000
classification.heap_corruption: launcher return code 0xC0000374 or correlated Event 1000 exception code c0000374
classification.manipulation_failure: loaded libwinpthread-1.dll path not inside the cell's launch directory

decision_rule.factor_implicated: both cells at one level reproduce, both cells at the other level have 0 faults, and the one-sided Fisher margin p<0.05 in that direction
decision_rule.interaction: exactly one cell reproduces, or the pattern fits neither main effect: reported as an interaction / single-cell result with its counts
decision_rule.no_reproduction: all 4 cells 0 faults: non-reproduction on this code path; neither factor implicated; per-cell 95% upper bound 4.9%
decision_rule.no_fix: no fix is implemented in this study; mechanism and recommended fix reported for a separate decision
